### Notes

Could not inspect: the Stytch Startup Program page itself. https://stytch.com/for-startups returns 308 -> /credits, which returns 307 -> /pricing; https://stytch.com/startups returns 404. The destination /pricing page contains NO occurrence of 'startup', 'Series A', 'incorporation' or 'free until', and stytch.com/sitemap.xml lists no startup-program URL. Therefore the program's terms (previously reported as free until Series A or three years from incorporation) could NOT be verified from any live Stytch page, and no amount is published here. Status is recorded as unverified rather than discontinued because Stytch publishes no statement of closure and no closure date. Re-confirmed 2026-09-16: the dedicated Stytch startup programme page no longer exists and the URL resolves to general pricing. The quoted figure is the standard always-free tier, not a startup offer.
